assumption: A hypothetical clinician is available; no professional appointment, registration or approval is inferred.

gates.requirement: Identify the clinical provider, accountable entity and applicable registrations and exemptions, including CQC scope and UK geographical coverage.
Record professional and prescriber registration checks, restrictions, indemnity, scope, credential expiry and removal procedure.
Approve medicine-specific eligibility, interactions, verification, titration, restart, monitoring, stopping and escalation protocols with current product information.
Approve the questionnaire and answer-to-action mapping; verify exact wording and lists persist with every submitted assessment.
Accept independent measurements, identity, history reconciliation and two-way consultation methods and their evidence requirements.
Approve informed consent, verified GP routing, sharing refusal/no-GP decisions and delivery-failure handling.
Validate legal prescription fields, signature mechanism, immutable prescription ID, pharmacy receipt and duplicate/revocation controls.
Accept pharmacy review, stock, labelling, patient checks, cold chain, dispatch, recalls and failed-delivery handling.
Agree monitoring, repeat review, safeguarding, urgent advice, incident reporting, service hours and cover.
Complete lawful basis and special-category analysis, controller/processor agreements, notices and DPIA actions; assess whether DPO appointment is required.
Approve category-specific retention and legal holds and test access/correction/deletion and backup/restoration processes.
AI identity remains off. Any future use needs separate supplier, accuracy, equality, human-review, biometrics and DPIA assessment.
Test genuine clinician/member authentication, MFA, session expiry, assignment revocation, authorised emergency access and isolation across all HQ/CRM routes.
Demonstrate upload validation/quarantine/scanning, private storage, signed access controls, access logs and failure recovery.

Apply approved schema, require structured handover, connect owned orders and member records, deliver notifications and verify prescription/pharmacy acknowledgements in a commissioned test environment.
Approve consultation/prescribing audit, sample review, amendments, clinical incident learning and complaints procedures.
Review public claims, medicine advertising, provider identities, checkout/payment timing, refunds and complaints without promising a prescription.

gates.owner: Business owner, clinical lead, pharmacy lead, privacy reviewer and security owner
gates.requirement: Record signed release decision after all included gates pass; perform controlled genuine end-to-end acceptance and name rollback and incident owners.
